newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Showpla unit in US$7.8 mln Delhi deal.
newsitem.headline: Showpla unit in US$7.8 mln Delhi deal.

text.p: Showpla Asia Ltd said on Monday its Delhi-based unit had taken over the plastic moulding unit of Onida Savak Ltd at a cost of US$7.9 million.
Showpla Asia said in a statement the deal would enable its Showpla (Delhi) Private Ltd (SPDL) unit to begin operations later this month.
SPDL was set up in December 1996 with a paid up capital of 20 rupees to manufacture and market plastic components used in automobiles and computer and telecommunication equipment.
Showpla said it was now applying to the Reserve Bank of India for the transfer of existing shares from its nominees in India.
The company also said it was restructuring Showpla Technology Centre Pte Ltd (STC) to consolidate Singapore operations under one roof and reduce overheads.
The move was effective from June 1.
